Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human Orexin/Hypocretin receptor type 1 (CHEMBL5113). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5113 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
